decisions.evidence: Skeptic overruled: NOT objects. The 'objects 0.8' seed is a name-prefix artifact - out/modules.seed.json records evidence 'name-prefix:object_render_state_refresh', and even CEA files object_render_state_refresh under render/ (vendor/halocea/src/blam/render/object_render_state_refresh.c), so the seed does not actually support objects. The OpenSauce name is also mis-mapped: CEA's object_render_state_refresh is lighting-cadence math with no D3D and no text, whereas 0x512b80 decompiles to SetVertexDeclaration/SetVertexShader + SetVertexShaderConstant + cull/colorwrite/alphablend/ztest/pointsprite render states + two DrawVerticesUP(&DAT_006b9280 / &DAT_006bc280, stride 0x18) + interface_set_bitmap_text_draw_mode(1,-1,0,0,5,0) + draw_8_bit_text of a title buffer and two sprintf("%d") labels. That is a line-for-line match for cea render/fg_render.c (fg_render(render_graph, render_infos): ortho consts, untextured point-sprite line state, 512-vertex plot strip + 5-vertex border, 'FPS' title plus max/average '%d' labels); unaff_BL is the render_graph flag. Family confirmed by neighbours sharing the fg globals: 0x512d90 shifts a 4-sample history and averages *0.25 over stride-0x32b0 structs = render/fg_add_sample.c, 0x512700 updates the 0x6b9260/0x6bc2xx fg info block, and the caller 0x512e80 is rasterizer_frame_statistics_draw (exact CEA string match) which per CEA 'renders the graph and the net graph'. Run stays contiguous; only the label rationale changes.

Skeptic right that it leaves the objects.c run, wrong on 'units'. Body matches cea models/scenery_animation_start_private.c line for line: early-out on (object_index==-1 || graph_index==-1); object datum via *(*(DAT_008603b0+0x34)+8+idx*0xc) (object_header_data DATA_ARRAY_ELEMENT->datum); TAG_GET via DAT_0087bc14 + tag_index*0x20 + 0x14; FUN_004d6ab0 = animation_graph_get_animation_by_name; on -1 console_warning(FUN_004c6920) with "the animation '%s' doesn't exist in the graph '%s'"; then object.flags &= ~0x80 (clear _object_animates_automatically_bit), *(uint*)(obj+500) |= 1 = SCENERY flags bit 0 at object+0x1F4 (unit_start_user_animation takes an interpolate flag and sets no scenery flag - so it is not the units variant), object.animation.state.index at +0xd0, graph index at +0xcc, frame clamped to animations[idx*0xb4 + 0x22].frame_count-1 at +0xd2, with the frame<0 branch writing 0 first. cea-string-hint models(1)/units(1) with no objects, plus a ~250-byte gap after 0x4fa500 (ends 0x4fa7d5), confirms a boundary: 0x4fa8d0-0x4faa1f is a 2-function scenery-animation mini-run, not objects.c.

Consequential fix, same mini-run as 0x4fa8d0: reads the identical object datum + tag path and tests the scenery flag bit 0 at object+500, then returns animations[state.index*0xb4+0x22].frame_count - state.frame_index - 2 clamped at 0 - the scenery_animation_* query paired with scenery_animation_start_private at 0x4fa8d0. Pull it out of the 0x4f67e0-0x4fa9b0 objects.c run; the objects.c run should end at 0x4fa7d5 and the widget run still starts at 0x4faa20.
